title: review follow-ups of PR #37619: refusal-list teaching on the hook and actions skill pages (the /data message bound, two wording nits)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review records 7197638051 and 7198330476 on PR #37619, nits N2, N4, N5, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37619 (Fixes #37407) teaches the multi-reason refusal throw on `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`. Its reviews left these items open:

- [ ] **The `/data` message bound is untaught** (N2). On `/data`, `userMessage` is cut at 500 characters (`CLIENT_MESSAGE_MAX`), so a long reasons list loses its closing line there. The page also says nothing about that bound for a single sentence. Expected: one clause on the hook page naming the bound.
- [ ] **"(rules there)" names no place** (N4). In `actions.md` "Refusing by code", the nearest place named earlier is `objectstack-i18n`, while the rules are in the hook section. Expected: name the hook section.
- [ ] **"door" has two senses on the hook page** (N5). "The HTTP doors answer `details.refusals`" sits beside the `ctx.title` row, where "door" means a hook registration path. The MCP tools are also reached over HTTP, but they relay the lines as text. Expected: name the routes (`/data`, `/actions`, the dispatcher).

Category ①: skill text (a shipped surface) that is incomplete or ambiguous on a refusal contract.
Priority: p3, wording on a shipped skill page.
Business reason: an agent that builds a long refusal list from the skill cannot see that the `/data` answer may lose its closing line.
Reader: the skills-lane dev who next edits either page (skills/** is governed, Tier H).
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37619"`: 0 hits.
Related: #37407, PR #37619, #36877.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read (`main` code against the two pages) · evidence: read → p3
